spec.baseline: Zero-trade PnL for economic comparison. For accounting review only, compare the corrected ledger against the preserved historical one-week hftbacktest artifact; do not use that old artifact as valid trade-level accounting evidence.

costs.assumptions: Maker fees are zero and emergency taker fills pay four basis points through hftbacktest's trading-value fee model. Spread crossing and timing shortfall are measured from actual simulated fills rather than imposed as a flat slippage rate. Funding is omitted from this short execution/accounting diagnostic and must be added before a longer-horizon economic qualification.

evaluation.plan: Run one continuous engine and nominal $500 capital account from 2026-01-01 through 2026-01-03. Do not tune signal or execution parameters. Reset Kalman state at each UTC day to preserve the historical signal process. Verify confirmed fills, flat exits, no overlapping trades, flat-to-flat PnL, execution attribution, and end-of-run flatness. Treat the period as observed diagnostic evidence, not as an unseen holdout.

spec.falsifier: The audit fails if any pair is declared open before both entry legs are confirmed, if any trade is declared complete before both exit legs are confirmed and positions are flat, if completed trade PnL does not reconcile to engine realized PnL, if the execution-attribution bridge has a material residual, or if the fixed strategy is net non-positive after measured execution and fees. A three-day result cannot by itself validate or reject long-run alpha persistence.

instruments.identity: USDT-margined linear perpetual; multiplier 1; tick 0.1; lot 0.001
USDT-margined linear perpetual; multiplier 1; tick 0.01; lot 0.01

spec.mechanism: The strategy trades short-lived deviations in the dynamic log-price relationship ln(ETH) = alpha_t + beta_t * ln(BTC). A one-hour standardized Kalman innovation supplies the fixed mean-reversion signal. Passive quoting attempts to capture spread and avoid fees, while re-pegs, emergency taker hedges, queue adverse selection, and latency can consume the gross relative-value edge.
spec.thesis: The fixed BTC/ETH online-Kalman residual mean-reversion strategy can be measured faithfully with maker-first execution when every pair entry and exit is confirmed flat-to-flat and execution shortfall is reconciled separately from gross alpha.

trials.description: Fixed-parameter Jan 1-3 execution/accounting audit. This period was already observed before the corrected runner and is not preregistered alpha evidence.
Preserve and review the original one-week result whose emergency-order lifecycle and per-trade accounting are known to be invalid.
